top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as CPI Data Fuel Fed-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary:
Stocks joined bonds lower as the fastest increase in inflation since April bolstered bets the Federal Reserve will keep lifting interest rates amid elevated energy costs. 
Kenneth Tropin, Chairman and Founder of Graham Capital Management, discusses the firms quant and discretionary investing strategies. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Novak Calls U.S. Diesel Deal a 'Positive Signal' for Russia's Economy
top_signals.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said on Wednesday that the diesel agreement with the United States is linked to higher Russian refining and production and means additional taxes for the budget. He spoke to journalists at Russian Energy Week in Moscow, calling the agreement "a positive signal for our economy", and saying it brings spending on the social sphere and opportunities for investment. top_signals.title: Bending Spoons Stock Soars on Berkshire’s Increased Stake
top_signals.summary: Shares of Bending Spoons surged as much as 55% after Berkshire Hathaway Inc. agreed to invest an additional $330 million in the Italian technology conglomerate. The investment brings Berkshire’s stake in Bending Spoons to 4% and gives Bending Spoons more capital to pursue acquisitions. Bloomberg's Matt Palazola joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
